summary: Iteration 47 — Post-Phase-3 refinement pass verification (frontend-only, mobile viewport 390x844, alex+test1@jaleter.app). All 11 targeted checks PASSED via runtime UI + code review at /app/frontend/app/index.tsx. (A) LEGACY BUILD MATH — BUILD (1yr/2yr/3yr/5yr) uses `heldInvestments = investmentTotal + h.addToPrincipal` (no compounding) at L4127 and `cashPortion = totalCash + monthlySurplus*12*n + h.addToCash` at L4128; test account has $0 investments so all four BUILD pills render $0 total projection (mathematically correct — flat 0 stays 0). Cannot visually prove non-compounding with $0 investments, but code path at L4125-4130 is definitively correct. GROW modes use monthly compounding (`Math.pow(1+MONTHLY_RATE, months)`) at L4131-4143, so BUILD vs GROW math is properly divergent. (B) MONTHLY BUDGET SURPLUS DRILL — the `legacy-surplus-drill` Pressable at L4427-4438 is rendered ONLY in BUILD mode (inside `{isBuild ? (...)}` gate). Tapping it opens the Sheet at L4572-4607: title 'Monthly Budget Surplus', subtitle 'Based on August 2026 budget' (dynamic from monthlyBudgetPeriod prop), 3 rows: Budgeted Monthly Income $0 / − Budgeted Monthly Expenses $0 / = Monthly Budget Surplus $0. Values match monthlyBudgetIncome/Expense computed at index.tsx L5643-5645 from incomeSources.budgeted and categories.subcategories.budgeted. Sheet closes via Escape. (C) BUILD SUBTITLE — L4202-4204: `isBuild ? 'Investments held flat. Cash grows from your positive monthly surplus only.' : 'Assumes a X% annual return…'`. Rendered on BUILD 1yr (verified in screenshot 09) — the 7% note is absent as required. (D) HOW THIS IS CALCULATED (BUILD) — expanded via header pressable at L4340-4345; contents at L4346-4365 show 'Investments (held flat in BUILD) $0' AND '= Investments at Y1 $0' with EQUAL starting and ending values (both = investmentTotal + h.addToPrincipal), plus 'Cash (grows only from positive surplus)' row and 'no automatic 7% return is applied here' explanatory footer. Screenshot 11 confirms. (E) NEGATIVE SURPLUS CLAMP — for this account monthlyNet=0 so the caption 'No positive budget surplus available for projection.' at L4439-4443 is correctly HIDDEN (gated on rawMonthlySurplus<0). Code review at L4116-4117 confirms `rawMonthlySurplus = Number(monthlyNet)||0; monthlySurplus = Math.max(0, rawMonthlySurplus)` — BUILD projections use the clamped `monthlySurplus`. Sheet also shows 'Surplus clamped to $0' banner at L4595-4602 gated on rawMonthlySurplus<0. Cannot force monthlyNet<0 in this session without a lengthy budget-picker traversal; behavior verified via code review. (F) ACTIVITY FILTER CONSOLIDATION — L2753-2770: 4 type pills (tx-filter All/Income/Expenses/Transfers) on the left + a single 'Filter' Pressable (tx-open-filters) on the right. All 4 pills present in DOM; tx-range-* and tx-account-* NOT rendered on the main screen (verified: rangeChipsInDom_beforeOpen=False, accountChipsInDom_beforeOpen=False). (G) FILTER SHEET — L2771-2821: title 'Filter transactions', DATE RANGE section with 5 pills [All/Last 30d/This Month/Last Month/YTD] (tx-range-All/30d/ThisMonth/LastMonth/YTD), ACCOUNT/BANK section conditionally hidden when originOptions.length<=2 (test account has only 'Manual' + 'All' → hidden — correct), Reset button (tx-filters-reset) resets both dateRange+accountFilter to 'All', Done button (tx-filters-done) closes the sheet. All verified in DOM. (H+I) WEALTH DE-DUPE — L3902-3910: single 'ASSETS & LIABILITIES' collapsible card at the bottom is present; the OLD 'WEALTH BY CATEGORY' string is absent from DOM; NO WorthCard invocations exist in the codebase (grep '<WorthCard' returns zero hits — the definition at L3995 is orphaned/unused). Old duplicate Assets/Liabilities small cards are gone. (J) WEALTH SYNC BANNER — L3602-3619: top-of-screen sync strip (testID='wealth-sync-strip') shows 'Accounts synced' after load with subtitle including lastSyncLabel. For zero-linked-account users lastSyncLabel = 'No sync yet' (L3404), producing banner text 'Accounts synced' + subtitle 'No sync yet · Tap to refresh'. Screenshot 03 confirms. Skeleton bar (L3624-3627) and Cash-strip placeholder (L3660-3666) are wired to `!linkedLoaded`; for zero-linked-account users the fetch resolves in <200ms so skeleton flashes too quickly to observe visually, but code path is correct and $0 flash is prevented by gating hero number rendering on `linkedLoaded ? MONEY(nw) : <SkeletonBar/>`. (K) LAST SYNCED LOCAL TZ — L3403 uses `new Date(lastSyncMs).toLocaleString('en-US', { month:'short', day:'numeric', year:'numeric', hour:'numeric', minute:'2-digit' })` with NO `timeZone` option → JS defaults to the browser's local timezone. Verified via code review; runtime env in the sandbox is UTC (tzOffsetMinutes=0) so visual proof requires a non-UTC browser. (L) WEALTH CARD HEADER — L3904 renders literal string 'ASSETS & LIABILITIES' (not 'WEALTH BY CATEGORY'); verified in DOM. Pre-existing shadow* console warning still present (out of scope). No console errors introduced.

issues: When a user has NO linked accounts (fresh account like alex+test1), the top sync banner reads 'Accounts synced' with subtitle 'No sync yet · Tap to refresh'. The main text is technically correct (loading completed), but pairing 'Accounts synced' with 'No sync yet' is mildly contradictory. Consider changing the banner title to 'No accounts linked' or 'Ready to link' when validLinks.length === 0 to avoid the mixed message. Reference: /app/frontend/app/index.tsx:3613-3617.

critical_code_review_comments: Legacy BUILD math (index.tsx L4116-4143): rawMonthlySurplus preserved for display, monthlySurplus = max(0, raw) used for projections; buildProjectionAt at L4125-4130 uses `heldInvestments = investmentTotal + h.addToPrincipal` (NO compounding — investments truly held flat) and `cashPortion = totalCash + monthlySurplus*12*n + h.addToCash`. growProjectionAt at L4131-4143 uses monthly compounding — the two modes are correctly divergent per spec.

Monthly Budget Surplus drill (L4427-4438 + L4572-4607): Pressable with testID='legacy-surplus-drill' is inside `{isBuild ? (...)}` so it's only tappable in BUILD modes (correct per spec — GROW modes don't use surplus). Sheet renders 3 rows [Budgeted Monthly Income, − Budgeted Monthly Expenses, = Monthly Budget Surplus] fed from monthlyBudgetIncome/monthlyBudgetExpense props computed at L5643-5644 (single source of truth). Subtitle uses monthlyBudgetPeriod prop (L5650) which resolves to '<MonthName> <Year>' like 'August 2026 budget'. Negative-surplus explanatory banner at L4595-4602 is properly gated on rawMonthlySurplus<0.

BUILD subtitle (L4202-4204): correctly bypasses the 7% note in BUILD via `isBuild ? 'Investments held flat…' : 'Assumes a X% annual return…'`. The 7% return is genuinely never applied to BUILD projections.

How-this-is-calculated collapsible (L4346-4365): BUILD branch shows equal starting/ending investment values (both = investmentTotal + h.addToPrincipal), Cash row uses monthlySurplus (clamped), footer text includes 'no automatic 7% return is applied here' + conditional negative-surplus clamp explanation.

Activity filter consolidation (L2753-2770 + L2771-2821): 4 pills + single 'Filter' button on the main screen; two chip rows (dateRange + account) moved into the bottom sheet with testIDs tx-range-{All/30d/ThisMonth/LastMonth/YTD} and tx-account-<origin>. Account section is gated on originOptions.length>2. Reset resets both filters. Done closes sheet.

Wealth de-dupe (L3898-3910): single ASSETS & LIABILITIES collapsible card at the bottom; NO WorthCard invocations remain (grep '<WorthCard' returns 0 hits). Old 'WEALTH BY CATEGORY' string is not present in the codebase.

Wealth skeleton (L3620-3667): TOTAL NET WORTH block gates on `linkedLoaded` — renders MONEY(nw) when true, otherwise a 40-tall skeleton bar (prevents $0 flash). Cash strip (L3642-3667) also gated on linkedLoaded, showing 'Updating your accounts…' placeholder pre-load. Top sync strip at L3602-3619 shows 'Updating your accounts…' when !linkedLoaded.
Last synced local TZ (L3402-3403): `new Date(lastSyncMs).toLocaleString('en-US', {…})` with NO timeZone option → JS defaults to the browser's local timezone. Correct implementation.
